title: Fix all reliability (1.31.3)
summary: Fix all no longer drops every rename for library-root members, shows a wait cursor and refuses a second fix, and keeps E-prefixed exception classes
intro: Read this if Fix all used to drop renames, ran twice, or flagged E-prefixed exception classes. Since 1.31.3-alpha library-root members no longer make an owner stale, the IDE shows a wait cursor and refuses a second fix while one runs, and exception classes keep their E prefix.

surfaces.caption: Fix all in unit
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Choose Fix all in unit; a wait cursor shows while it runs and a second fix is refused until it finishes
